t: You're looking at a statue of Hugh Dowding, standing outside the front of St Clement Danes church on the Strand. It's one of three statues here, and it pairs with the statue of Arthur Harris, both made by the sculptor Faith Winter. Dowding was an Air Chief Marshal in the Royal Air Force, and he led Fighter Command during the Battle of Britain. He's generally credited with a crucial role in Britain's defence, and so in the defeat of Operation Sea Lion, Hitler's plan to invade. Winter is known for statues and memorials of military and historical figures in British towns and cities.
